name: The Herrick household at 2018 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_herrick_mrs_l_a

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2018 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 2018 Mrs. L. A. Herrick; Miss Louise Herrick; Mrs. Nicolas de Teresa; Miss Ysabel de Teresa.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2018, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. In 1900 F. A. Delano lived here, not the Herricks. The census says nothing about this household's staff. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. L. A. Herrick
persons.note: The card is anchored on the older Mrs. Herrick; the Blue Book does not say who headed the house.

persons.name: E. Walter Herrick
persons.note: Listed at 2018 in the 1904 edition, not in the 1905 one; his relation to Mrs. Herrick is not printed.

persons.name: Louise Herrick
persons.note: A daughter is read from 'Miss' and the shared surname under Mrs. Herrick; the Blue Book does not state the relationship.

persons.name: Mrs. Nicolas de Teresa
persons.note: Listed at 2018 in both editions; her relation to the Herricks is not printed.

persons.name: Isabel de Teresa
persons.note: The 1904 OCR reads 'Isabel', the 1905 'Ysabel'. A daughter of Mrs. de Teresa by the name; the relation is not printed.
